array.string: umask 077 source "$HOME/.config/prb/env_core.sh" state_dir="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/cleanshot-screenshot-renamer" mkdir -p "$state_dir" exec >>"$state_dir/agent.log" 2>&1 source "$HOME/.config/prb/path.sh" exec "$HOME/.config/prb/bin/cleanshot_screenshot_renamer_macos.sh"
